reader.title: Free PDF Reader & Editor
reader.description: Read PDFs and CBR comics, open direct file links, and use fullscreen reading or stylus writing. Annotate and export PDFs locally.
reader.heading: Your quiet reading space, with room to think.
steps: Open a PDF or CBR from your device, paste a direct file link, or start a new page.
Choose fullscreen reading, or write, draw lines, refine shapes, and mark up your pages.
Adjust color and width. Use undo, search, bookmarks, and page navigation as you work.
Download a PDF with portable annotations, or flatten a copy when you need a static result.

faqs.q: Can I read manga and comic archives?
faqs.a: Yes. Open a CBR with JPG, PNG, or WebP pages, choose single-page or two-page reading, and switch the reading direction for manga.

faqs.q: Can I use Apple Pencil?
faqs.a: The reader accepts pen pointer events and pressure values where your device and browser provide them. Finger drawing is optional; stylus and touch behavior still depends on the hardware.

faqs.q: Can I rewrite existing PDF paragraphs?
faqs.a: You can add text and annotations. Reflowing or rewriting existing paragraphs while preserving the original layout is not included.

scan.title: Scan to PDF — Free Document Scanner
scan.description: Scan documents with a camera or uploaded photos. Correct perspective, reduce uneven lighting, and make PDFs without uploading your pages.
scan.heading: A paper document, a clearer digital copy.
steps: Capture a page or upload photos from your device.
Adjust the four crop corners, then try Clean paper or another filter.
Set shadow reduction, brightness, contrast, and a page layout.
Create your PDF and download it or save it to your local workspace.

faqs.q: Do I need a camera?
faqs.a: No. You can import photos, screenshots, and existing scans from Files on any supported device.

faqs.q: Does shadow removal recover hidden text?
faqs.a: Lighting normalization can reduce uneven shadows. It cannot reconstruct covered text, strong glare, severe blur, or curved-book detail.

enhance.title: Enhance Scans — Filters & Shadow Reduction
enhance.description: Clean up document photos with adjustable crop corners, grayscale and black-and-white filters, brightness, contrast, and shadow reduction.
enhance.heading: Let your document stand out from its shadows.
steps: Upload the document photo you want to improve.
Adjust the crop corners and correct its perspective.
Compare Clean paper, Grayscale, Black and white, and Vivid color.
Hold the original preview to compare, then export a new copy.

faqs.q: Will my original photo change?
faqs.a: No. The tool creates an enhanced copy. Your source photo is not overwritten.

faqs.q: Which filter should I choose?
faqs.a: Clean paper helps uneven lighting, grayscale removes color distractions, and black-and-white increases text contrast. Review small print before exporting.

merge.title: Merge PDF — Combine PDFs Free
merge.description: Combine multiple PDFs into one file in your browser. Arrange file order and download a merged copy without a subscription.
merge.heading: One neat document, from a handful of files.
steps: Choose the PDF files you want to combine.
Move files up or down to set their order.
Provide the current password for protected sources when needed.
Merge and download the combined document.

faqs.q: Does merging turn pages into images?
faqs.a: The page-copying workflow preserves document text and vector content where the source structure supports it.

faqs.q: Can I merge encrypted PDFs?
faqs.a: You need the current source password. Files using different passwords are best unlocked separately before merging.

split.title: Split PDF — Separate Pages & Ranges
split.description: Split a PDF into individual pages or selected page ranges. Create just the documents you need, locally in your browser.
split.heading: A long document, divided into useful pieces.
steps: Open your source PDF.
Choose one file per page or enter page ranges.
Use ranges such as 1-3, 5, 7-9 to define output files.
Download individual PDFs or a ZIP containing the results.

faqs.q: How do page ranges work?
faqs.a: A comma separates output groups. For example, 1-3, 5 creates one PDF for pages 1 through 3 and another for page 5.

faqs.q: Are the original pages deleted?
faqs.a: No. Splitting creates new files and leaves the original PDF unchanged.

organize.title: Organize PDF Pages — Reorder & Duplicate
organize.description: Reorder, rotate, duplicate, and remove PDF pages with visual page previews and touch-friendly move controls.
organize.heading: Every page, in the right place.
steps: Open a PDF to see page previews.
Drag pages or use the move buttons to change their order.
Rotate, duplicate, or remove the pages you need.
Save an organized copy and review its final sequence.

faqs.q: Can I organize on a phone?
faqs.a: Yes. Move buttons provide an alternative to dragging, so the same page operations are available on touch devices.

faqs.q: Is there a preview limit?
faqs.a: The organizer previews up to 60 pages. Split larger documents into smaller sections before visual organization.

extract.title: Extract PDF Pages — Keep Selected Pages
extract.description: Create a new PDF from selected pages or page ranges. Keep the useful parts without changing the original file.
extract.heading: Keep the pages that tell your story.
steps: Choose your PDF.
Enter individual pages or ranges, such as 2-4, 8.
Check the range against the source page count.
Export the selected pages as a new PDF.

faqs.q: Can I repeat pages with Extract?
faqs.a: Extract keeps each selected source page once. Use Organize pages to duplicate a page.

faqs.q: Will links and text remain?
faqs.a: The tool copies PDF pages rather than rasterizing them. Some document-level links or structures may depend on their original context.

remove.title: Remove PDF Pages — Delete Unwanted Pages
remove.description: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF and save a clean copy. Enter page numbers or ranges with clear validation.
remove.heading: A little less clutter in your document.
steps: Open the source PDF.
Enter the pages to remove, such as 1, 6-8.
Keep at least one page in the output.
Export the remaining pages in their original order.

faqs.q: Can I delete every page?
faqs.a: A PDF needs at least one page. The tool prevents an empty output.

faqs.q: Does this delete my original PDF?
faqs.a: No. The tool exports a new copy; it cannot delete your downloaded original.

rotate.title: Rotate PDF — Fix Page Orientation
rotate.description: Rotate selected PDF pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees. Fix sideways pages without converting them to images.
rotate.heading: A better angle on your paperwork.
steps: Open a PDF.
Choose a rotation angle.
Enter a page range, or leave it blank to rotate every page.
Save and check the orientation of the output.

faqs.q: Can I rotate only some pages?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter individual page numbers or ranges to target only those pages.

faqs.q: Does rotation reduce image quality?
faqs.a: Page rotation changes PDF orientation metadata. It does not re-encode page images in this workflow.

compress.title: Compress PDF — Local PDF Optimization
compress.description: Optimize PDF size locally. Choose lossless cleanup or an explicitly flattened image copy for sharing smaller documents.
compress.heading: A lighter file, with a clear choice of tradeoffs.
steps: Open your PDF and choose a compression mode.
Try lossless optimization to preserve text, forms, and page structure.
Use an image copy only when flattening and rasterization are acceptable.
Compare the output size and review the saved copy.

faqs.q: Is a smaller file guaranteed?
faqs.a: No. Some PDFs are already optimized. Lossless mode returns the original bytes when rewriting would make the file larger.

faqs.q: What does image compression remove?
faqs.a: Raster output can lose selectable text, links, interactive fields, and vector sharpness. Use it only when those features are not needed.

repair.title: Repair PDF — Recover Readable PDF Structure
repair.description: Try rebuilding a damaged PDF from readable structures. Best-effort recovery runs locally and creates a separate copy.
repair.heading: Give a difficult document another chance.
steps: Choose the damaged PDF.
Enter its current password if it is encrypted.
Run best-effort structural recovery.
Open the repaired copy and verify all important pages.

faqs.q: Can every damaged PDF be repaired?
faqs.a: No. Missing bytes, truncated content, or severely corrupted structures cannot always be reconstructed.

faqs.q: Should I trust the repaired copy immediately?
faqs.a: Review page count, text, images, and important fields. Successful saving does not prove that every part of a damaged source was recovered.

ocr.title: OCR PDF & Images — Searchable PDFs Free
ocr.description: Recognize English, Persian, or Arabic text locally. Export plain text or create a searchable PDF from scans and images.
ocr.heading: Give your scanned words a text layer.
steps: Upload a scanned PDF or document image.
Choose English, Persian, or Arabic.
Select text extraction or searchable PDF output.
Wait for local recognition, then review and export.

faqs.q: Are scans sent to an OCR server?
faqs.a: No. The browser downloads an OCR engine and language model, then recognizes your document on the device.

faqs.q: How accurate is the recognized text?
faqs.a: Accuracy depends on language, layout, image quality, and handwriting. Check names, numbers, and important wording against the original.

image-pdf.title: Images to PDF — JPG, PNG & Photo PDFs
image-pdf.description: Turn photos, screenshots, and supported images into a PDF. Choose A4, Letter, original size, or document copy layouts.
image-pdf.heading: Your images, together on paper.
steps: Choose one or more images.
Adjust scans if they need crop or lighting corrections.
Choose A4, Letter, original image size, or an ID/passport copy layout.
Create and download your PDF.

faqs.q: Can I combine front and back of an ID?
faqs.a: The ID copy preset arranges your first two genuine document photos on one PDF page.

faqs.q: Are these official document templates?
faqs.a: They are neutral copy layouts for authentic user-provided scans. They do not create credentials or guarantee government acceptance.

pdf-image.title: PDF to JPG & PNG — Export PDF Pages
pdf-image.description: Render PDF pages as JPG or PNG images with selectable output widths. Download pages separately or together as a ZIP.
pdf-image.heading: A picture of every page.
steps: Open your PDF.
Choose JPG for compact images or PNG for lossless image encoding.
Set the output page width.
Export page images and download them or a ZIP.

faqs.q: Will the exported images contain editable text?
faqs.a: No. Page images are raster pictures. Keep the PDF or use text/OCR tools when you need selectable words.

faqs.q: Can I make WebP images?
faqs.a: Export PNG or JPG pages, then use Convert images to create WebP copies.

image-convert.title: Convert Images — JPG, PNG & WebP
image-convert.description: Convert supported images to JPG, PNG, or WebP locally. Make compatible copies without uploading private photos.
image-convert.heading: The right image format for the next step.
steps: Choose your source images.
Select JPG, PNG, or WebP output.
Convert the images on your device.
Download the converted files or a ZIP.

faqs.q: Which format is best for documents?
faqs.a: PNG is useful for crisp graphics, JPG often saves space for photographs, and WebP can offer efficient web images.

faqs.q: Can my browser open HEIC?
faqs.a: HEIC decoding depends on the browser and operating system. If it cannot open the image, export a JPG or PNG from Photos first.

text.title: PDF to Text — Extract PDF Words
text.description: Extract selectable text from a PDF into a plain text file. Keep processing local and use OCR for image-only scans.
text.heading: Just the words you need.
steps: Upload a text-based PDF.
Enter the current password if required.
Extract the text layer.
Download the result and check reading order.

faqs.q: Why is my scan empty?
faqs.a: Scans may contain images without a text layer. Run Recognize text first to add or extract OCR text.

faqs.q: Are columns preserved?
faqs.a: Plain text has no page layout. Reading order can vary in multi-column pages and complex tables.

markdown.title: PDF to Markdown — Simple Text Export
markdown.description: Export PDF text to Markdown with page sections. Move document words into your notes or writing workflow.
markdown.heading: From a fixed page to flexible notes.
steps: Choose a text-based PDF.
Extract its text layer.
Export Markdown with separate page headings.
Review structure and refine it in your Markdown editor.

faqs.q: Will every heading and table be reconstructed?
faqs.a: No. This export creates readable page sections from extracted text, without reliably inferring complex semantic structure.

faqs.q: Does it support scanned PDFs?
faqs.a: Run OCR first for documents that contain only page images.

word.title: PDF to Word — Editable Paragraph Export
word.description: Convert PDF text to an editable DOCX document. Local paragraph extraction with clear layout limitations and no subscription.
word.heading: A useful starting point for editing the words.
steps: Open a PDF with selectable text.
Use OCR first if the PDF is image-only.
Export text as Word paragraphs.
Review formatting, reading order, and page sections in Word.

faqs.q: Will it look exactly like my PDF?
faqs.a: No. This is editable text conversion, not a reconstruction of the original layout, charts, or typography.

faqs.q: Can I edit the result in other apps?
faqs.a: The output is a DOCX file that compatible word processors can open. Review the converted document before sharing.

excel.title: PDF to Excel — Export Text Rows
excel.description: Export inferred PDF text rows to an XLSX workbook. A local starting point for organizing tabular text.
excel.heading: Bring useful rows into a workbook.
steps: Choose a PDF with a text layer.
Export inferred rows and columns.
Open the XLSX workbook in a compatible spreadsheet app.
Check column boundaries, decimal values, and dates.

faqs.q: Does it reliably detect complex tables?
faqs.a: No. Columns are inferred from spacing in extracted text. Merged cells, irregular tables, and multi-column layouts need review.

faqs.q: Can I use a scanned table?
faqs.a: Run OCR first. Recognition errors in digits and separators can affect spreadsheet results.

powerpoint.title: PDF to PowerPoint — PDF Pages as Slides
powerpoint.description: Make a PowerPoint presentation from PDF page images. Preserve each page visually as an image on a slide.
powerpoint.heading: Your pages, ready for the screen.
steps: Open your PDF.
Render the pages at a suitable resolution.
Export a PPTX presentation.
Open the slides and add your presentation notes.

faqs.q: Is slide text editable?
faqs.a: No. Each exported slide contains an image of a PDF page. Use text extraction if you need to rewrite the words.

faqs.q: Will portrait pages be stretched?
faqs.a: The page images are fitted proportionally to widescreen slides, with space around them when needed.

office-pdf.title: Office to PDF — Basic DOCX, XLSX & PPTX Copies
office-pdf.description: Create basic PDF reading copies from DOCX, XLSX, or PPTX text and data. Browser-local conversion with explicit layout limits.
office-pdf.heading: A simple reading copy of the content.
steps: Choose a modern DOCX, XLSX, or PPTX file.
Extract its readable text or worksheet data locally.
Create a clean PDF reading copy.
Check that all important content appears.

faqs.q: Is this a full Office rendering engine?
faqs.a: No. Complex layouts, charts, images, slide design, and original fonts are not faithfully reproduced.

faqs.q: Are old DOC, XLS, or PPT files supported?
faqs.a: No. Save them as DOCX, XLSX, or PPTX in a compatible Office app before using this tool.

faqs.q: Can I convert Persian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, or Indic text?
faqs.a: Yes. Text conversion uses script-aware shaping, local Noto fonts for supported Arabic and Indic scripts, and CJK fallback fonts. Persian and Arabic paragraphs use right-to-left layout. This creates a reading copy; complex original Office layouts are not reproduced.

html-pdf.title: Text & HTML to PDF — Clean Reading Copies
html-pdf.description: Create a PDF from plain text, Markdown, or HTML text content. Scripts, styles, and external resources are excluded.
html-pdf.heading: A clean page for what you wrote.
steps: Choose a TXT, Markdown, or HTML file.
Extract readable content locally.
Create a simple PDF with consistent typography.
Open the result and review page breaks.

faqs.q: Will it capture a live website?
faqs.a: No. This tool converts text from an uploaded file. It does not browse a URL or reproduce a styled web page.

faqs.q: Can embedded scripts run?
faqs.a: The conversion excludes script and style content and does not load external resources from the uploaded HTML.

faqs.q: Does it support accented and non-Latin characters?
faqs.a: Yes. Extended Latin, Persian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and common Indic scripts use Unicode text layout with script font fallback. Text remains selectable in the generated PDF.

sign.title: Sign PDF — Add a Drawn Signature
sign.description: Draw a signature and place it on a PDF page. Create a signed visual copy locally without a subscription.
sign.heading: A familiar signature, in the right place.
steps: Open your document.
Draw your signature with a pen, mouse, or touch.
Choose the page, size, and placement.
Export a new PDF and review its appearance.

faqs.q: Is this a certificate-backed digital signature?
faqs.a: No. This feature places a drawn signature image. It does not provide identity certification, timestamps, or a digital-signature service.

faqs.q: Can I use it on a form?
faqs.a: Yes. Place the visible signature where needed. Verify the recipient’s requirements before relying on any signature method.

annotate.title: Add Text to PDF — Type Notes & Labels
annotate.description: Type new text on a PDF page. Position notes, labels, and missing details while keeping the original content.
annotate.heading: A few useful words, right on the page.
steps: Open the PDF.
Choose a page and type your text.
Tap the preview to place it and adjust the text size.
Save a new copy, or open the full reader for more annotations.

faqs.q: Can I change an existing paragraph?
faqs.a: This tool adds new text. It does not reflow or rewrite the document’s existing paragraphs.

faqs.q: Can I write by hand too?
faqs.a: Use PDF reader & editor for pen strokes, pressure-aware drawing, highlights, and sticky notes.

watermark.title: Watermark PDF — Add Ownership or Status
watermark.description: Add a text watermark to PDF pages. Label a document as a draft, confidential copy, or personal reference.
watermark.heading: Make the document’s purpose clear.
steps: Choose your PDF.
Enter the watermark text.
Adjust its opacity and placement settings.
Export and review a watermarked copy.

faqs.q: Does a watermark prevent copying?
faqs.a: No. A watermark is a visual label, not access control or copy protection.

faqs.q: Should I watermark identity-document copies?
faqs.a: A purpose-specific watermark can help communicate intended use. Keep required details legible and follow the recipient’s instructions.

numbers.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF — Number Pages
numbers.description: Add page numbers to a PDF with a chosen starting number. Make longer documents easier to reference.
numbers.heading: A small detail that keeps everyone aligned.
steps: Open your PDF.
Choose the starting page number.
Add numbering to the page sequence.
Review the footer area in the exported copy.

faqs.q: Can numbering start above one?
faqs.a: Yes. Set a starting number to match a larger combined document or appendix.

faqs.q: Will it replace existing numbers?
faqs.a: The tool adds a new number overlay. Existing page-number content is not automatically removed.

crop.title: Crop PDF — Trim Visible Page Margins
crop.description: Trim visible PDF margins with a crop box. Create a cleaner view while keeping the underlying document content.
crop.heading: A closer view of the useful part.
steps: Open your PDF.
Choose the margin to trim.
Apply the visible-page crop.
Check that no useful content is hidden.

faqs.q: Does cropping remove sensitive content?
faqs.a: No. Cropped content can remain in the file. Use Redact content when information must be removed.

faqs.q: Will the original file change?
faqs.a: No. Cropping creates a separate PDF copy.

forms.title: Fill PDF Forms — Complete Interactive Fields
forms.description: Fill supported text, checkbox, radio, and choice fields in an existing PDF form, then save a completed copy.
forms.heading: Your form, a little closer to finished.
steps: Open an interactive PDF form.
Enter text and choose available field values.
Save a completed PDF copy.
Review the form in a PDF reader before sending.

faqs.q: Why are there no fields in my scan?
faqs.a: A flat scan contains a page image rather than interactive fields. Use Add text or the full reader to write on it.

faqs.q: Can I fill certificate signature fields?
faqs.a: Certificate signature fields and unsupported form technologies are not completed by this tool.

protect.title: Protect PDF — AES-256 Password Encryption
protect.description: Encrypt a PDF with an opening password using AES-256. Keep document processing local and save a protected copy.
protect.heading: A password at the document’s front door.
steps: Open your PDF.
Choose a strong opening password.
Create an encrypted copy.
Test the password before sharing it through a separate channel.

faqs.q: Can a forgotten password be recovered?
faqs.a: There is no password recovery service. Keep the password in a safe place.

faqs.q: Are all password characters accepted?
faqs.a: The interface rejects option-delimiter characters used by the underlying writer. Use a long unique password that meets its validation rules.

unlock.title: Unlock PDF — Remove a Known PDF Password
unlock.description: Save an unlocked PDF copy using its current password. Local decryption for documents you are authorized to access.
unlock.heading: A more convenient copy, when you know the key.
steps: Choose the encrypted PDF.
Enter its current opening password.
Save an unlocked copy.
Store the output appropriately because it no longer requires that password.

faqs.q: Does this crack unknown passwords?
faqs.a: No. It requires the current password and does not guess or bypass it.

faqs.q: Is the encrypted original overwritten?
faqs.a: No. The source remains unchanged and the tool creates a new unlocked PDF.

redact.title: Redact PDF — Remove Selected Page Content
redact.description: Remove PDF page content in a selected rectangle and rewrite the file. Use real content redaction rather than a covering box.
redact.heading: Remove the content, not just the view of it.
steps: Open your PDF and choose a page.
Draw a rectangle over the content to remove.
Apply redaction and export a rewritten copy.
Search and inspect the result before sharing it.

faqs.q: Is a black rectangle enough?
faqs.a: A normal drawn rectangle can leave text underneath. This tool uses the PDF engine’s destructive redaction operation.

faqs.q: Does it sanitize every part of a file?
faqs.a: No. Metadata, attachments, and other document-level information need separate review. Check every sensitive page and the final output.

compare.title: Compare PDFs — Side-by-Side Page Views
compare.description: Create a side-by-side PDF comparison aligned by page number. Review two versions visually without uploading them.
compare.heading: Two versions, with room to look closely.
steps: Choose two PDFs.
Align the documents in the desired original/comparison order.
Create a side-by-side comparison PDF.
Inspect wording, layout, and page differences visually.

faqs.q: Does it detect every text change?
faqs.a: No. This is visual comparison, not semantic difference detection or a legal review.

faqs.q: What if the page counts differ?
faqs.a: The comparison uses the longer document’s page count and leaves missing counterpart areas blank.

flatten.title: Flatten PDF — Bake Forms & Annotations
flatten.description: Create a static PDF copy with supported form and annotation appearances baked into the pages.
flatten.heading: Keep the appearance, simplify the interaction.
steps: Open a PDF containing forms or annotations.
Flatten the current appearances into the pages.
Export a static copy.
Review fields, comments, and signatures before sharing.

faqs.q: Can flattened fields be edited later?
faqs.a: They are no longer interactive fields in the flattened copy. Keep an editable original.

faqs.q: Does flattening preserve a digital signature?
faqs.a: Editing or rewriting a PDF can invalidate existing cryptographic signatures. Check signature requirements separately.

metadata.title: Edit PDF Metadata — Title, Author & Subject
metadata.description: Set a PDF title, author, and subject locally. Make document details clearer without changing the original file.
metadata.heading: A useful label behind the file name.
steps: Choose your PDF.
Enter the document title, author, and subject.
Save a new copy with updated metadata.
Check its document properties in a reader.

faqs.q: Does clearing metadata remove all private information?
faqs.a: No. Visible text, attachments, custom structures, and other information may remain. This tool changes the supported metadata fields.

faqs.q: Will the file name change?
faqs.a: The export uses a new output name. Metadata titles and file names are separate document properties.

summary.title: Summarize PDF — Local Extractive Key Sentences
summary.description: Select key sentences from a text-based PDF with a local extractive summary. No external AI service or document upload.
summary.heading: A shorter route back to the source.
steps: Choose a PDF with selectable text.
Set how many key sentences to extract.
Create a summary from existing source sentences.
Read important points in their original context.

faqs.q: Is this generative AI?
faqs.a: No. It ranks and selects sentences already present in the document. It does not create new claims or translate content.

faqs.q: Can I rely on it instead of reading?
faqs.a: It is a reading aid. Frequency-based sentence selection can miss context, exceptions, and important details.
